ticks.note: `press`: `BellVariable` sets `ding` to true, `BellSignal` emits `ding`. Both read true after this tick.
Nothing fires. The variable keeps the value it was given; the signal is absent, because nothing emitted it in this tick.
The same: the variable stays true.
Another press: the signal is present again. The variable was true all along.
To make the variable read like the signal, something would have to set it back to false in every tick after the press.
